title: timerange
summary: Create a timetable row-time range selector object.
description: `timerange(startTime, endTime)` returns a row-time selector with `Start`, `End`, and `Inclusivity` properties.
behaviors: The optional third argument sets inclusivity and defaults to `"closed"`.
The selector can be used as a timetable row subscript.

examples.output: Rows whose row times are between 1 and 3
